event.description: Reduce the learned positional factorization from rank 8 to rank 7 while retaining its learned projection, d=14, h=2, L=2, and ff=20.
event.proposal: Family: position representation. Retained incumbent is 3430 parameters at 99.660000%, a +0.660000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: the most recent accepted result is attempt-0012, learned positional rank 8 (3430, 99.66%); the most recent failed result is attempt-0017, fixed-basis expansion of rank-8 codes, an optimization failure with 92.55% peak validation under its initial schedule; 4 prior family macro-attempts. The immediately preceding rank-10-QKV attempt-0023 is an optimization failure (30000 steps, 0% peak validation, no checkpoint), not an official nonqualification. Hypothesis: rank 7 may preserve the positional role capacity retained at rank 8 while removing one learned code coordinate and its 14-dimensional projection, reducing actual parameters from 3430 to 3381; the recorded rank-6 failure makes this one-rank boundary especially informative. This is a representational positional factorization, not parameterization-preserving scalar pruning. It is more informative than the nearest untested rank-5 alternative because rank 7 directly resolves the single-coordinate gap between the retained rank 8 and failed rank 6 conditions.
